CustomField.description: How many attached documents carry a markup a signer submitted with their approval or decline (#412 M2). Set when a signer finishes. On a Signed request, more than 0 means approved with comments; blank or 0 means approved as-is. Lets a Flow tell the two apart in one condition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Attached documents marked up by a signer. On a signed request, more than 0 means it was approved with comments.
CustomField.label: Marked-Up Documents
